title: Novel amide-based macrocyclic Co(II) complexes: correlating structural, computational, and biological properties through DFT and docking
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,3169-3191
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA08873A, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Subhash, Manish Kumar, Vandana, Annu Devi, Ashu Chaudhary
Amide-based macrocyclic Co(II) complexes with octahedral geometry were synthesized and characterized by spectral, thermal and DFT studies. The complexes showed enhanced antimicrobial and antioxidant activity, supported by docking results.
